cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: More Official Than You
cards.instruction: Turn every suggestion into a contest over whose method, title, precedent, or paperwork is more legitimate.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Your picnic rota is useful. Mine has committee approval. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Mine got everyone to bring sandwiches.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Mine establishes who was entitled to request those sandwiches.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Then approve mine. We've already started eating.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Gladly. I'll attach it as an appendix to mine, so lunch has a legitimate basis.

mechanism: A claims superior committee legitimacy for a picnic rota and accommodates B successful plan only as an appendix to A own.
confusable: Unlike requesting one governing rule, A compares whose paperwork has the more legitimate authority at every reply.
comparison: Practical sandwich rota absorbed into a document differs from a ceremony founder written exception.
seedUse: D187-a picnic appendix; S02-a keeps participants eating and doing B plan while formally subordinating it.
